purpose: exact label interface the FINAL teacher must emit for each of the 5,552 selected structures at the join point (NO labeling performed now)

per_structure_fields.structure_hash: str sha256[:16] (must match frozen manifest — integrity check)
per_structure_fields.teacher_identity: str (e.g. b56e20ff or the GPU-remediated teacher name)
per_structure_fields.energy: float, eV, TOTAL energy (SIMPLE-NN divides by n_atoms internally)

struct_weight: NOT a teacher output — computed by the CPU workflow from natoms (Policy C); attached at str_list build
integrity_rule: reject any returned label whose structure_hash/natoms mismatch the frozen manifest (deterministic gate)
output_format: extxyz per structure with energy=/forces + info(teacher_identity, teacher_sha256, structure_id, structure_hash, label_run_id); OR a labels JSON keyed by structure_id
consumed_by: SIMPLE-NN feature generation (energy+forces only) -> PC003 training
